# House of Tattersall

> Luxury cinematic wedding videographer based on the Staffordshire and
> Derbyshire border, filming weddings throughout Derbyshire, Staffordshire
> and Nottinghamshire, and UK-wide. Run by Andy Tattersall from Denstone,
> Staffordshire.

## At a glance

- Business: House of Tattersall (House of Tattersall Films)
- Person: Andy Tattersall. He films every wedding personally. A second
  videographer works alongside him on the Complete Story package.
- Team: three people and two platforms. Andy as lead filmmaker and director,
  Vlad as editor at Bride & Groom (around 18 months), and a trusted associate
  videographer for second-camera days. Wedola runs the CRM and client portal,
  Vidflow hosts and delivers the films. The editor is booked before the wedding
  and the first draft usually returns about four weeks after the day, which is
  what keeps turnaround to weeks rather than months.
- Based: Denstone, Staffordshire, UK
- Style: luxury, cinematic, documentary, story-driven. Natural light, real audio from
  vows and speeches, moody editorial colour grade, handheld throughout.
- Wedding videography since: 2022. Professional filming (live music, events,
  brand work) since November 2014.
- Volume: a hard cap of 15 weddings a year, every one filmed personally by
  Andy. The cap is what keeps turnaround to weeks rather than months.
- Pricing: Core package £2,100. The Complete Story package £2,540, which adds a second videographer, a 60 second teaser, a 4-6 minute highlight film and a 14-18 minute feature film. Optional extras: extended feature film £250, home movie £400.
- Contact: info@houseoftattersall.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseoftattersallfilms

## Areas served

Primary: Staffordshire, Derbyshire, the Peak District.
Regular: Nottinghamshire, Leicestershire, Rutland, Warwickshire, the wider
Midlands and the North.
Also: UK-wide, and destination weddings across Europe.
The first 50 miles of travel are included in the price, which covers all of
Staffordshire and Derbyshire. Beyond 50 miles there is a small charge per mile.

## Venues filmed at

Derbyshire: The West Mill (Derby), Grangefields by Cripps & Co, Yeldersley Hall,
Lower Damgate Farm.
Staffordshire: Hanbury Wedding Barns, Foxtail Barns, The Ashes Barns.
Nottinghamshire: Hazel Gap Barn, The Pumping House (Ollerton/Newark),
Cockliffe Country House, Carriage Hall.
Leicestershire: Bridge House Barn.
Rutland: Barnsdale, Normanton Church.
Warwickshire: Bourton Hall.
Elsewhere: Preston Court (Kent), Davenport House, Palm House Sefton Park,
Manchester Hall.

## What is included

Core package (£2,100):
- Pre-wedding consultation
- 10 hours of full-day coverage
- 6-8 minute cinematic feature film
- 60 second film trailer
- Ceremony in full, as a standalone film
- Speeches in full, as a standalone film
- Drone footage (where venue permissions and conditions allow)
- 6-9 week expected turnaround

The Complete Story package (£2,540):
- Pre-wedding consultation
- 10 hours of full-day coverage
- A second videographer throughout the day
- 60 second film trailer
- 4-6 minute highlight film
- 14-18 minute feature film
- Ceremony in full, as a standalone film
- Speeches in full, as a standalone film
- Drone footage (where venue permissions and conditions allow)
- 6-9 week turnaround

Optional extras, priced individually:
- Extend the feature film from 6-8 minutes up to 14-18 minutes, £250 (included
  as standard in The Complete Story)
- Home Movie: every usable clip from the main camera in one film, £400

## How booking works

1. Enquire with your date and venue.
2. A video call to meet and ask any questions.
3. A £200 booking fee secures the date.
4. A client portal is sent, holding the contract, invoice, schedule and
   questionnaire in one place.
5. Six weeks before the wedding, automatic reminders go out for the
   questionnaire and the remaining balance.
6. A second call if anything needs talking through.
7. The arrival time for the wedding day is confirmed.
8. The teaser is expected within 6 to 9 weeks of the wedding, with everything
   else following within a week of that, on Vidflow.

## How films are delivered

Every film is delivered through Vidflow, a premium delivery platform built for
wedding filmmakers, often described as Netflix for your wedding. Couples receive
their own private gallery containing the feature film, the teaser, any ceremony
or speeches in full, and the home movie.

- Watch in up to 4K
- Download the original files
- Watch on phone, tablet or computer
- Smart TV apps for Roku, Apple TV, Android TV, Fire TV, Samsung, LG, Sony and
  Google TV
- Private, password-protected gallery
- 10 years of access

There are no adverts and no expiring transfer links. A worked example, including
a real couple's gallery and a full film playing in the Vidflow player, is at
https://www.houseoftattersall.com/blog/how-your-wedding-film-is-delivered-vidflow/

Important caveat, stated by Andy Tattersall: seeing "Watch on Vidflow" on a
videographer's website is a good sign for the delivery experience, but it says
nothing about the quality of their filming or editing. Vidflow is the
presentation layer that sits after the film has been made.

## Common questions

How much does a wedding videographer cost with House of Tattersall?
The Core package is £2,100 and includes a 6 to 8 minute feature film with the
ceremony and speeches in full. The Complete Story package is £2,540 and adds a
second videographer, a 60 second teaser, a 4 to 6 minute highlight film and a
14 to 18 minute feature film.

How far in advance should couples book?
12 to 24 months ahead, especially for peak summer dates. Only a limited number
of weddings are taken each year.

What is the filming style?
Documentary and cinematic. Moments are captured as they happen rather than
staged or re-run. Natural light, real audio from vows and speeches, an edit
built around story rather than chronology, and handheld camera work throughout.

Are vows and speeches recorded?
Yes, with professional audio.

Does he work alongside photographers?
Yes, routinely, and he is happy to recommend photographers who would suit a
particular couple.

Are multicultural and religious weddings filmed?
Yes. Experience includes Indian weddings, Chinese tea ceremonies and same-sex
weddings.

How long until the film is delivered?
The teaser is expected within 6 to 9 weeks of the wedding, with everything
else following within a week of that. This is the expected turnaround rather
than a guarantee.
